messages.text: My starting preference is Guild navigation and joint military authority. Those institutions should become capable of governing without my repeated intervention. I need evidence that route maintenance will actually happen and that both military delegates can agree a useful operation before their deadline. Protecting communities, sustaining the beacon and preserving a viable army matter together. I will consider other articles if the proposed service arrangements work better. I will not grant autonomy merely because its title sounds generous, or retain command merely because I can.

goals: Ratified settlement with Beacon at least 1, Communities at least 2 and Readiness at least 2
Prefer Readiness at least 3 and intact Spear
Delegate on demonstrated service and workable decisions
reason: Permanent institutions need tested responsibilities, and the civilians bearing our military costs deserve an explicit place in the bargain.
